analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price ($79.59) vs SMA5 ($78.75)/SMA20 ($75.28)/SMA50 ($74.52) — short/mid-term trend above, long-term trend below SMA100 ($82.99)/SMA200 ($88.42)

· MACD histogram trajectory (0.8529→0.7531) + slowing improvement diagnosis + weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (near mid-band $75.28) + 14.87% band width indicating expansion phase
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($79.23) + pivot-based
· Swing resistance ($84.66) + potential for stronger uptrend on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern sideways + lack of directional trend

· Volume ratio (0.75x) + reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + consider buy on confirmation of $79.23 support, further buy on breaking $84.66 resistance
